title: Designer
summary: Help us make the posters, social posts and merch that get people in the room.
responsibilities:
Make roughly two designs a month, or one per event
Work from a short brief and a couple of rounds of feedback
Hand off files in a format the next designer can reuse
skills: Canva, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, an eye for type and colour
commitment: Freelance-ish - the work comes in bursts around events
question_1: Link a design you're proud of (any format)

title: Hackathon team member
summary: Help plan and run HackED and HackED Beta, from sponsor outreach to the day itself.
responsibilities:
Attend planning meetings through the term
Reach out to potential sponsors and follow up
Help run the event across both hackathon days
skills: Organisation, clear email and messaging, comfortable talking to companies. No hackathon experience needed.
question_1: Which part interests you most: sponsorship, logistics, or running the event on the day?

title: Photographer
summary: Take photos and video at our events so the club has something worth posting the next day.
responsibilities:
Shoot at one or two events a month
Pick and lightly edit the best shots
Upload them to the club Drive within a few days
skills: Your own camera or a good phone, basic editing (Lightroom, Photos, CapCut), an eye for candid moments
commitment: Per event - a few hours each
